description: Path rules become Allow and Disallow lines under robots.txt longest-match rules; exact patterns end in $; the guard keeps search engines out.
policy:
version: 1
mode: enforce
purposes:
  training: block
  user_fetch: allow
paths:
  "/blog/*":
    training: allow
  "/blog/drafts/*":
    verified: block
  "/private":
    user_fetch: block
emit: [robots.txt]
expected:
# robots.txt written by Posterna from agents.yaml.
# Crawlers that honor robots.txt are asked to stay out of what the policy blocks.
# The site's policy engine enforces against agents that do not.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Training
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /
Allow: /blog/
Disallow: /blog/drafts/

# Search
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: Googlebot-News
User-agent: Storebot-Google
Disallow: /blog/drafts/

# User-initiated fetches
User-agent: Claude-User
Disallow: /blog/drafts/
Disallow: /private$

# Other
User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot
User-agent: Google-InspectionTool
User-agent: GoogleOther
User-agent: GoogleOther-Image
User-agent: GoogleOther-Video
Disallow: /blog/drafts/
